title: Native point library read binding
summary: Refer to a Core-supplied gemia PointLibraryPackage by stable name, version and semantic contract hash. Catalog access receives no APIs, permissions or editable boundary. A layer may bring the library's catalog and verification record, which a read then answers with; the binding stays the native one.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No deadline. Exact name/version/hash and native-point-library-read surface required; schemas are Host-owned. With a library field, the layer's catalog and verification are read from its package files and held to a .lup's rules and to English, and their digest is recorded. Binding/surface/schema mismatches raise ValueError, which the Host loads as E_LUC_CAPABILITY_INVALID; a layer the agent could not read is E_LUC_LANGUAGE.

operations.name: describe_capability

output.description: Compiled capability with native_operations catalog/describe and editable_native_binding=false.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: invoke

output.description: ToolResult wrapping native package dispatch output.

operations.notes: No deadline. create/adjust/apply explicitly refuse as ToolRefused; other op values are delegated via asyncio.run to the native package, or with a layer to the native package carrying the layer's version, catalog and verification, re-read and checked against the digest taken at load (E_LUC_LIBRARY_CHANGED). Native dispatch errors/results depend on gemia and are not closed by this adapter.

invariants.text: create, adjust and apply cannot reach native rendering or edit execution through this adapter.
A layer's library is data the native read answers with; the binding to native code, and its pins, stay as they shipped.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: The layer tests ran for this change (tests/test_luc_library_layer.py). Structural checking does not establish live availability.

known_deviations.text: The public descriptor advertises catalog and describe, but invoke blocks only three write op names and otherwise delegates to native dispatch. The native package remains a required trust boundary.
